outcome: The Lab now has a recorded 'before' photograph that later refactoring must reproduce exactly
owner_impact: Nothing changes in how the Lab looks or behaves. Behind the scenes, five reference Experiments (the catalog Active Elastic Experiment, its random-start variant, and small examples covering controller randomness, per-agent state, the scalar Environment and named references) are now compiled and run on every change. Their compiled form, every agent's final position and every metric value must match the recorded reference to the last bit, both in the browser's simulator and in the native one, and in both the Lab and the AI connection. Any future refactor that changes a result, even in the 15th digit, is stopped before it is published.

next.text: Next is #533 — reliable release loop. It will check each new version in a real browser before it is published, stop releases from being cancelled halfway, and give every agent one reliable way to wait for its exact version, while keeping 'done means verified live'. #533 has not started.

technical_evidence: New: web/tests/fixtures/reference-experiments.mjs, web/scripts/reference-runs.mjs, web/scripts/reference-runs-wasm.mjs, crates/kernel/tests/reference_runs.rs, web/scripts/sync-edge-vendor.mjs, web/tests/behaviour-reference.test.mjs.
Browser and MCP edge compilers reproduce the recorded compiled artifacts and exact simulator input for all 5 reference Experiments.

Native (cargo test) and production WebAssembly (new CI step after wasm-pack) replay 803 metric samples and final agent state bit-identically, with 100-tick and 7-tick batching giving identical results.
Mutation checks: a 1e-15 change in periodic distance, swapped pow arguments in the Controller and Metrics compilers, and a changed RNG uniform mapping are each caught.
Native and WebAssembly trajectories differ by up to ~1e-13 because of platform math libraries; recorded separately and documented as audit finding F17.
The 8 edge-function compiler copies are checked by one list/test; the Docker database tests skip locally and are required in CI via VLAB_REQUIRE_DOCKER=1.
